Fact: distribution_channels
What to find: Methods of distribution (open weights on repositories, API, cloud platforms, apps).
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Availability, Distribution, Access

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card describes distribution as released model weights (BF16 for Llama 4 Scout, with on-the-fly int4 quantization code), loadable via Hugging Face transformers with the model id meta-llama/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct, under the Llama 4 Community License. It also says quantized checkpoints are provided.
quotes: The Llama 4 Scout model is released as BF16 weights, but can fit within a single H100 GPU with on-the-fly int4 quantization
We've provided quantized checkpoints for deployment flexibility, but all reported evaluations and testing were conducted on bf16 models.
License: A custom commercial license, the Llama 4 Community License Agreement, is available at: https://github.com/meta-llama/llama-models/blob/main/models/llama4/LICENSE
